body.name: Generic statistical exception set
body.construction: For \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\mathcal E_C\) is the finite union, over \(D\in\mathfrak S_p\) with \(d_D\leq d_C\) and \(\mathcal M(D)\neq\mathcal M(C)\), of the polynomial pullbacks to \(\Theta_C\) of \(\mathcal M(C)\cap\mathcal M(D)\), together with the polynomial zero-gradient loci of the nonconstant coordinates reported by \(\mathcal T_C\).
